purpose: Provider-neutral production runtime configuration contract. Contains names and rules only; never secret values.

notes: INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL is server-only and must never be exposed as NEXT_PUBLIC_*.
AI configuration is optional and cannot become PASS/FAIL or competence authority.
S3-compatible storage is required when NODE_ENV=production.
PostgreSQL outbox remains authority; Redis/BullMQ is transport only.
At-least-once delivery is expected and consumers must remain idempotent.
Trusted dispatcher may hold object-storage read credentials; learner sandbox receives none.
VERIFIER_RUNTIME_IMAGE_DIGEST must be an immutable sha256 digest.
Production hostile execution still requires the locked runsc/gVisor boundary.

globalInvariants: No default or committed production secret values.
Completion is not competence; runtime configuration cannot bypass the canonical evidence chain.
AI Coach remains formative and optional.
System/verifier infrastructure errors are not learner FAIL outcomes.
Live provider binding and secret injection are deployment-execution concerns and remain DEFERRED while AWS execution is skipped.
